findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露最大客戶約占 2025 合併淨銷售 11%，無其他客戶超過 10%；公司稱無法保證留住最大客戶，部分客戶未來可能轉向競爭對手。搜尋未找到最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的具體來源。
findings.excerpt: Our net sales to our largest customer represented approximately 11% of our consolidated net sales in 2025. While we do not have any other customers that accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated net sales in 2025, we have other customers that are key to the success of our business.

note: 搜尋未查到最大客戶導入第二供應商或 in-house 的具體來源；僅有第三方分析提及 hyperscaler 自製液冷風險，未取得可逐字原文。
